The '''TIE scout''',<ref name="Alphabet Squadron" /> also known as a '''scout-class TIE''',<ref name="TROS EE" /> was a [[starfighter]] variant of the [[TIE series|TIE family]] of [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[warship]]s that was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]] and was used for reconnaissance missions.<ref name="Alphabet Squadron" /> As with all [[Starship|space crafts]] of the [[Imperial Era]]-TIE line,<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> the [[scout ship]]<ref name="Alphabet Squadron" /> was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" />

One functional TIE scout was present within the [[Death Star ruins|wreckage]] of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] on [[Kef Bir]] by the [[time]] of the [[Resistance]]'s [[mission to Kef Bir]],<ref name="TROS EE" /> which took place long after the [[Death Star]]'s [[Battle of Endor|destruction]] over [[Endor]].<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> It was used by the stranded [[Ben Solo]] to depart from the [[ocean]] [[moon]] and travel to<ref name="TROS EE" /> the distant [[Sith]] world of [[Exegol]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="TROS date">{{Film|IX}} events is dated to [[35 ABY]] as ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary'' states its events took place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which took place in [[34 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. Because the film depicts a TIE scout being commandeered by [[Ben Solo]], the event must also have occured in 35 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].</ref> There, the [[Jedi]] evaded<ref name="TROS EE" /> the [[planet]]'s chaotic [[atmosphere]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> as he landed the [[Realspace|space]] craft before the [[Sith Citadel]] with success, and made for the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] on foot for a [[Battle of Exegol|final confrontation]].<ref name="TROS EE" />
